pages.text: These large bird-like dinosaurs possess strength that should not be underestimated either. Using their favorite food, Trilocaris, you can lure a Relicheirus under your control.
Briar and Bramble, Logger Vick is here to chop trees again!

Wearing Wild Robe restores your dinosaurs' health. Feeding them Raw Trilocaris Tails heals your Relicheirus. Tree Stars can be used to breed your Relicheirus; a breeding pair will lay an egg, and the hatchling will still recognize you as its master.
Feeding your Relicheirus Servant Primordial Soup puts it into a logging state. They will knock down surrounding trees, though they obviously cannot collect the dropped items.
